contract: FreightLens local operations workbench. At1440x1000 show compact header, intake and primary queue together; at390x844 stack the layout and contain wide tables. Findings precede evidence and employee decisions. Status filters/search, keyboard orientation, truthful provider labeling, usable state feedback and no automatic approval are required. Full contract: docs/design.md.

accessibility.evidence: Browser verified first keyboard stop is Skip to workspace, Enter focuses main, opening a packet focuses its heading, source buttons expose aria-pressed, blocked approval is disabled and described, and reduced motion sets automatic scrolling. Interactive controls use44px minimum height. Small heading/placeholder/footer/count text colors were adjusted to calculated contrast ratios4.65,4.64,4.53,4.51; evidence links5.75. This is focused keyboard/manual inspection, not a screen-reader certification.

responsive.evidence: Rendered at1440x1000,1024x900 and390x844. documentElement.scrollWidth equals innerWidth at each viewport, including selected review. A browser-only fixture stressed180-character references, long carrier/filename/quotes; mobile title and quote did not clip. Wide data tables scroll inside labelled focusable regions.

loading.evidence: Delayed list response by2500ms in the browser; stable queue loading message shown and empty state remained hidden. Mutation commands expose pending aria-disabled state; progress is announced as a status.

empty.evidence: Controlled empty list displays first-review guidance; actual status/search filtering with a nonexistent reference displays No matching reviews and functional Clear filters.

error.evidence: Controlled503 response displayed actionable service feedback and Retry. Removing the fixture and clicking Retry restored the real queue. Blank upload also displayed a useful validation error.

partial.evidence: Actual synthetic FL-1003 packet contains two documents. Its available fields and evidence remain visible, missing delivery record is flagged, and approval stays blocked.

success.evidence: Uploaded the three actual synthetic clean PDFs through the interface, approved with a name/note, observed approved download link and disabled repeated approval. Search and status filters and note isolation also checked.

permission.reason: This loopback-only single-user prototype has no authentication/role permission or consent dialog. Workflow approval restrictions were verified in partial/success states. Provider keys are configured locally outside the interface; public access control remains future work.
